# POS Return Requirements Checklist: POS Return by Transaction Number

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements for POS-initiated sales returns are complete, clear, consistent, and ready for implementation.
**Created**: 2026-05-01
**Feature**: POS return by POS transaction number requirements intake. A `spec.md` has not been created for this feature yet.

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on the requested POS return requirements and existing Sales Return/POS domain context. Items evaluate the quality of the requirements, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are eligibility requirements defined for who may initiate a POS return by POS transaction number, including the required permission boundary? [Completeness, User Input]
- [ ] CHK002 Are separate requirements documented for create, edit, delete, view, approve, receive, and dispatch product-return permissions? [Completeness, User Input]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec define the complete lifecycle states for a POS return from initiation through approval, receipt, dispatch, settlement, rejection, cancellation, or deletion? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the allowed return options limited and named consistently as cash return and product replacement? [Completeness, User Input]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the POS transaction snapshot fields that must be populated after entering a POS transaction number? [Gap, User Input]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements specified for mapping one POS transaction to all sales created by split POS ownership posting? [Completeness, User Input, Reference: openspec/specs/pos-checkout-split-posting/spec.md]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements documented for reducing dispatch quantity by returned quantity for each returned product? [Completeness, User Input, Reference: Modules/SalesReturn]
- [ ] CHK008 Are product replacement requirements defined for the replacement product, quantity, source location, dispatch requirement, and relation to the original returned item? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "POS trx number" defined with the exact source field, accepted aliases, uniqueness rules, and relationship to POS checkout records? [Ambiguity, User Input]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "snapshot of that POS transaction" clarified with exact data fields, monetary values, ownership groups, bundle components, dispatch state, and read-only versus editable fields? [Ambiguity, User Input]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "eligible user by permission" clarified with explicit permission names and whether Super Admin or POS owner bypass behavior applies? [Ambiguity, Reference: openspec/specs/pos-role-bundles/spec.md]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "approval flow" specified with actors, approval statuses, reject behavior, resubmission rules, and whether approval is required before receipt or settlement? [Ambiguity, User Input]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "return cash" clarified as cash refund, customer credit exclusion, payment-method reversal, or another settlement model? [Ambiguity, User Input]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "product replacement" clarified as a dispatchable replacement flow rather than repair, exchange, or unprocessed settlement? [Ambiguity, Reference: Modules/SalesReturn/Entities/SaleReturnDetail.php]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "cannot parent only" for bundles translated into objective selection rules for parent rows and every included component row? [Clarity, User Input, Reference: openspec/specs/pos-standalone-bundle-row-posting/spec.md]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 Are POS return permissions consistent with existing POS permission-governance and sales-return permission naming conventions? [Consistency, Reference: openspec/specs/pos-permission-governance/spec.md]
- [ ] CHK017 Are POS return approval requirements consistent with the existing Sales Return approve, reject, receive, settlement, and dispatch concepts? [Consistency, Reference: Modules/SalesReturn/Routes/web.php]
- [ ] CHK018 Are dispatch-quantity reduction requirements consistent with existing Sales Return behavior that modifies dispatched quantities instead of creating an unrelated stock reversal model? [Consistency, User Input, Reference: Modules/SalesReturn]
- [ ] CHK019 Are split-ownership reversal requirements consistent with POS split posting rules for `source_setting_id`, source location, tax bucket, and sale ownership? [Consistency, Reference: openspec/specs/pos-checkout-split-posting/spec.md]
- [ ] CHK020 Are bundle return requirements consistent with persisted POS bundle component rows that may be linked or standalone-compatible? [Consistency, Reference: openspec/specs/sales-standalone-bundle-rows/spec.md]
- [ ] CHK021 Are replacement-dispatch requirements consistent with existing Sales Return dispatch request, approval, and dispatch item concepts? [Consistency, Reference: Modules/SalesReturn/Http/Controllers/SaleReturnDispatchController.php]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK022 Are success criteria measurable for finding a POS transaction by transaction number and presenting an immutable source snapshot? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Are success criteria measurable for preventing returns by users lacking each required permission type? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Are success criteria measurable for approving, rejecting, receiving, and dispatching POS returns across the intended lifecycle? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap]
- [ ] CHK025 Are success criteria measurable for ensuring returned quantities never exceed the still-dispatched quantities for the relevant sale detail or bundle component? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 Are success criteria measurable for ensuring every POS split sale affected by a return receives the correct ownership-aligned reversal? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap, Reference: openspec/specs/pos-checkout-split-posting/spec.md]
- [ ] CHK027 Are success criteria measurable for bundled POS sales requiring all included bundle items to be returned together with the bundle parent? [Acceptance Criteria, User Input]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Are primary-flow requirements complete for entering a POS transaction number, reviewing the populated transaction snapshot, choosing return quantities/options, submitting, approving, and completing the return? [Coverage, User Input]
- [ ] CHK029 Are alternate-flow requirements defined for partial returns of non-bundled POS sale lines? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 Are alternate-flow requirements defined for full and partial bundle returns, including whether partial bundle quantity returns require proportional component quantities? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 Are exception-flow requirements defined when the POS transaction number is not found, belongs to another setting, is not posted, or has already been fully returned? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Are exception-flow requirements defined when the POS transaction created multiple sales with different owners, locations, tax buckets, or dispatch records? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Reference: openspec/specs/pos-checkout-split-posting/spec.md]
- [ ] CHK033 Are recovery requirements defined for approval or settlement failures after some, but not all, ownership-aligned dispatch reductions have been prepared? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for serial-tracked products returned from POS transactions, including serial selection and reuse state? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK035 Are requirements defined for stock-managed and stockless bundle components in POS returns? [Edge Case, Reference: openspec/specs/pos-checkout-split-posting/spec.md]
- [ ] CHK036 Are requirements defined for tax-bearing and non-tax POS split sales so reversal quantities and monetary return amounts remain aligned to the original owner tax policy? [Edge Case, Reference: openspec/specs/pos-checkout-split-posting/spec.md]
- [ ] CHK037 Are requirements defined for multiple returns against the same POS transaction, including cumulative returned quantity limits and duplicate prevention? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK038 Are requirements defined for archived, rejected, cancelled, or deleted sales returns and how they affect future POS return eligibility? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK039 Are authorization requirements specified for every UI route, server action, and data lookup involved in POS returns? [Security, Gap]
- [ ] CHK040 Are audit requirements defined for who created, edited, deleted, approved, received, dispatched, rejected, or settled a POS return? [Auditability, Gap]
- [ ] CHK041 Are data-scope requirements defined so POS return lookup cannot expose transactions outside the user's permitted setting or ownership scope? [Security, Gap]
- [ ] CHK042 Are performance requirements specified for POS transaction number lookup and snapshot population on realistic POS transaction volumes? [Performance, Gap]
- [ ] CHK043 Are UI consistency requirements documented against the existing Sales Return screens, including page structure, statuses, actions, and settlement/dispatch presentation? [UX Consistency, User Input, Reference: Modules/SalesReturn/Resources/views]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK044 Are dependencies on existing Sales Return entities, statuses, settlement methods, receive flow, and dispatch flow documented? [Dependency, Reference: Modules/SalesReturn]
- [ ] CHK045 Are dependencies on POS checkout records, generated sales, sale details, sale bundle items, dispatch details, and ownership split metadata documented? [Dependency, Reference: Modules/Pos, Modules/Sale]
- [ ] CHK046 Is the assumption that reducing dispatch quantity is the authoritative return mechanism documented and reconciled with inventory transaction reporting? [Assumption, User Input]
- [ ] CHK047 Is the assumption that cash return and product replacement are the only supported POS return options explicitly documented? [Assumption, User Input]
- [ ] CHK048 Is the assumption that bundle parent-only returns are prohibited documented in both selection and validation requirements? [Assumption, User Input]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK049 Is there a resolved requirement for whether POS returns create a new Sales Return record, extend the existing Sales Return module, or introduce a POS-specific wrapper over Sales Return? [Ambiguity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK050 Is there a resolved requirement for whether edit and delete permissions are allowed after approval, receive, settlement, or dispatch events? [Ambiguity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK051 Is there a resolved requirement for monetary handling when a POS transaction had split or staged payments but the return option is cash return? [Ambiguity, Reference: openspec/specs/pos-multi-stage-payment-flow/spec.md]
- [ ] CHK052 Is there a resolved requirement for how replacement dispatch affects original sale ownership when replacement stock is sourced from a different owner or location? [Ambiguity, Gap]
